Effective date: January 2026

1. About This Policy

This Policy explains shipping and delivery terms for purchases from Buudy.

In this Policy:

  • Store means Buudy.
  • xPage Drop means xPage Drop LLC.
  • Seller means the independent merchant operating the Store.
  • Fulfillment Partner means a supplier, manufacturer, warehouse or carrier.
  • You means the buyer.
  • We, us and our mean the Store and xPage Drop where it coordinates fulfillment.

2. Shipping Destinations

We ship to the destinations listed during checkout.

We may restrict delivery to remote areas, military destinations, forwarding addresses, PO boxes or territories affected by trade or courier restrictions.

3. Free Shipping

Free shipping rules are shown at checkout or on the product page:

Free shipping: Free shipping is available on all qualifying orders, subject to the conditions displayed at checkout.

Where paid shipping applies, the cost is displayed before payment.

4. Processing and Transit Times

Estimated timelines are:

  • Order processing: 1–3 business days
  • Standard delivery: 7–20 business days

Delivery estimates begin after the order is processed and handed to the carrier. Business days exclude weekends and public holidays.

Estimates are guidelines unless expressly stated as guaranteed.

5. Order Tracking

A tracking reference or link will be provided by email after dispatch where available from the carrier.

Tracking information may take 24–72 hours to update after dispatch.

6. Address Accuracy

You must provide an accurate and complete delivery address, including any apartment, suite or unit number, and a reachable phone number.

Address changes may be requested within:

Address change period: Delivery address changes must be requested within 2 hours of order placement. Requests submitted within this period are not guaranteed once an order has entered processing.

We cannot guarantee address corrections after fulfillment begins.

Additional carrier fees or losses resulting from an incorrect address provided by the buyer may be the buyer's responsibility where legally permitted.

7. Delivery Issues

Contact support promptly if your order is delayed, damaged or marked delivered but not received.

For missing or damaged packages, we may ask for photos of the packaging and product, carrier confirmation or a written non-receipt statement to investigate with the carrier.

We will arrange a replacement, refund or other lawful remedy if a package is confirmed lost in transit.

8. Customs and Import Taxes

Import rules are shown before purchase:

Customs and duties: Import duties and taxes depend on the destination and order. Review the current checkout disclosure before payment.

Where duties or taxes apply, they are the buyer's responsibility unless the checkout specifically states that taxes and duties are included.

9. Contact

For shipping questions, support or delivery issues, contact:

Email: support@buudy.co.uk

Contact form: Contact Us

Customer service hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM EST

xPage Drop LLC

131 Continental Dr Suite 305, Newark, DE 19713, United States

Email: support@buudy.co.uk

This is a corporate address only. It is not a warehouse, fulfillment center or return address.
documents.return-policy:
Effective date: January 2026
Last updated: January 2026
Version: 1.0

1. About This Policy

This Policy applies to purchases from Buudy.

In this Policy:

  • Store means Buudy.
  • xPage Drop means xPage Drop LLC.
  • Seller means the independent merchant operating the Store.
  • Fulfillment Partner means a supplier, manufacturer, warehouse or carrier.
  • You means the buyer.
  • We, us and our mean the Store and xPage Drop where it handles the request.

2. Contact Support First

Before cancelling or returning an order, contact:

support@buudy.co.uk or Contact Us

You must receive written return authorization before sending a product. The approved return address may differ from:

  1. The shipping origin.
  2. The address printed on the package.
  3. The Fulfillment Partner's address.
  4. The xPage Drop corporate address.

Do not return products to any address without written authorization.

3. Order Cancellations

Cancellation requests may be submitted within:

Cancellation period: Cancellation requests must be submitted within 12 hours of placing the order. Cancellation is only possible if fulfillment has not started. Requests submitted within this period are not guaranteed once the order has entered processing.

We will try to stop the order, but cancellation cannot be guaranteed after payment review, preparation, customization, packaging or fulfillment begins.

If cancellation succeeds, the cancelled amount will be refunded to the original payment method. After fulfillment begins, you may need to receive the order and request a return.

4. Change-of-Mind Returns

Change-of-mind returns may be requested within:

Return window: Within 30 days of delivery

Returned products must meet these conditions:

Return condition: Returns are accepted only for damaged, defective, incorrect or missing products. Customers must provide clear photo or video evidence and obtain return authorization before sending anything back. Items must not be returned to the address shown on the package. Change-of-mind, incorrect-size or personal-preference returns are not generally accepted.

You may inspect a product as reasonably necessary, but you may be responsible for reduced value caused by use, damage or handling beyond normal inspection where permitted by law.

5. Defective, Damaged or Incorrect Products

Contact support promptly if a product:

  1. Is defective or unsafe.
  2. Arrives damaged.
  3. Is materially different from its description.
  4. Is the wrong item, size, color or model.
  5. Is missing parts or quantities.
  6. Does not function as reasonably advertised.

We may request reasonable evidence such as photographs, measurements, packaging information or a short video showing the issue.

An unboxing video is not the only accepted evidence.

Depending on the issue and applicable law, the remedy may include replacement, missing parts, repair, partial refund or full refund.

6. Missing Items and Lost Shipments

Check whether your order was divided into separate packages before reporting a missing item.

For a missing item, provide photographs of the received package, label and contents where reasonably available.

If an item was omitted or a shipment is confirmed lost, we will provide a replacement, refund or other remedy required by law.

7. Delayed Shipments

Delivery estimates are not guarantees unless expressly stated otherwise.

A reasonable delay does not automatically qualify for a refund. However, if delivery materially exceeds the promised period, you may receive a revised delivery option, cancellation or refund as required by law.

You are not required to accept an indefinite delay.

8. Return Shipping Costs

The applicable return-cost rule is:

Return shipping: Return shipping costs are the customer's responsibility unless Buudy confirms otherwise in writing. Products must not be returned without prior authorization and return instructions.

For validated defective, damaged, incorrect or materially misdescribed products, we will provide a prepaid method, reimburse reasonable authorized return costs or provide another remedy required by law.

Unauthorized or unnecessarily expensive return shipping may not be reimbursed.

9. Return Inspection

Returned products may be inspected before a refund is approved. The inspection may confirm:

  1. The correct product was returned.
  2. The product is complete.
  3. The reported defect exists.
  4. The product was not intentionally damaged or replaced.
  5. The return conditions were followed.

A lawful deduction may be made for missing parts, unauthorized damage or excessive use. Normal inspection will not remove mandatory return rights.

10. Non-Returnable Products

Subject to mandatory law, the following products may not qualify for change-of-mind returns:

Non-returnable products: Products are non-returnable when the request is based on a change of mind, personal preference, an incorrectly selected product, variant or size, an incorrect shipping address, minor cosmetic imperfections, packaging damage without product damage, or failure to complete customs clearance.

This may include personalized, perishable, hygiene-sensitive or opened sealed products where legally permitted.

A non-returnable classification does not remove rights relating to defective, unsafe, incorrect or materially misdescribed products.

11. Refunds

Approved refunds will normally be sent to the original payment method.

Refund initiation time: 5–10 business days

Your bank or payment provider may require additional time to display the refund.

Where the original payment method cannot receive the refund, another lawful method may be requested.

Original delivery fees will be refunded where required by applicable law.

12. Partial Refunds and Replacements

A partial refund may be offered if you choose to keep a product with a minor issue.

A replacement may be offered for defective, damaged, incorrect, missing or lost products. A materially different replacement will not be sent without your approval.

A partial refund or replacement will not replace a remedy that applicable law requires.

13. Refused and Unauthorized Returns

Do not refuse a package or send a return without contacting support.

Unauthorized returns may be refused, lost or delayed. You may be responsible for avoidable costs resulting from failure to follow reasonable return instructions.

This does not remove mandatory consumer rights.

14. Fraudulent or Abusive Claims

We may reject a claim involving materially false or misleading information, intentional damage, substitution of products, false non-delivery statements or duplicate recovery attempts.

Exercising a legitimate refund, consumer-protection or chargeback right is not abuse.

We may provide relevant order, delivery, refund and communication records to payment providers or competent authorities when fraud is reasonably suspected.

15. Chargebacks

Contact Buudy support before opening a chargeback so the issue can be reviewed directly. This does not restrict legitimate chargeback rights.

Do not seek both a completed refund and a chargeback for the same amount. An active chargeback may pause a separate refund while the payment provider controls the disputed funds.

16. Mandatory Rights

Mandatory cancellation, return, conformity, warranty and refund rights in your jurisdiction remain applicable.

Where local law grants a longer return period, free return, legal guarantee or stronger remedy, that law prevails over conflicting parts of this Policy.

17. Contact and Return Warning

For questions or assistance with returns, contact:

Email: support@buudy.co.uk

Contact form: Contact Us

xPage Drop LLC

131 Continental Dr Suite 305, Newark, DE 19713, United States

Email: support@buudy.co.uk

This is a corporate address only. It is not a warehouse, fulfillment center or standard return address. Do not send a return here or to the address printed on a package unless Buudy expressly provides that address in writing.

1. About This Policy

This Privacy Policy explains how personal information is handled when you visit or purchase from Buudy.

In this Policy:

  • Store means Buudy.
  • xPage Drop means xPage Drop LLC.
  • Seller means the independent merchant operating the Store.
  • Service Provider includes payment providers, suppliers, warehouses, carriers, analytics services and fraud-prevention providers.
  • You means the visitor or buyer.
  • We, us and our mean the Store and xPage Drop for the relevant processing activity.

xPage Drop handles customer support and may process personal information for checkout, payments, fraud prevention, order administration, refunds and fulfillment coordination.

2. Information We Collect

We may collect:

  1. Your name, email address, phone number and delivery address.
  2. Billing, order, product, currency, tax and shipping information.
  3. Payment status, payment method, transaction references and limited payment details.
  4. Device, browser, IP address, approximate location and usage information.
  5. Cart activity, Store visits and referral information.
  6. Cookies and similar technologies.
  7. Support messages, attachments, complaints and refund requests.
  8. Tracking, delivery and return information.
  9. Fraud, identity, age or sanctions-verification information where necessary.

Full payment credentials may be collected directly by the payment provider rather than by the Store or xPage Drop.

3. How We Use Information

Information may be used to:

  1. Operate the Store and checkout.
  2. Process payments and orders.
  3. Arrange fulfillment and delivery.
  4. Send order and tracking updates.
  5. Provide customer support.
  6. Process cancellations, returns and refunds.
  7. Prevent fraud, abuse and unauthorized transactions.
  8. Investigate delivery and payment disputes.
  9. Comply with tax, customs, sanctions, safety and legal obligations.
  10. Maintain Store and payment security.
  11. Measure and improve Store performance.
  12. Send marketing where permitted.

Where required, processing will rely on your consent, performance of the purchase contract, legal obligations or legitimate business and security interests.

4. Cookies and Analytics

The Store may use cookies and similar technologies for:

  1. Cart and checkout functions.
  2. Security and fraud prevention.
  3. Language and session preferences.
  4. Analytics and Store improvement.
  5. Marketing where permitted.

Non-essential cookies will be subject to consent or opt-out controls where required by law. Blocking essential cookies may affect Store functionality.

5. How Information Is Shared

Information may be shared with:

  1. The Seller, where necessary to operate the Store.
  2. Suppliers and warehouses preparing products.
  3. Carriers delivering orders.
  4. Payment providers and financial institutions.
  5. Fraud-prevention and identity-verification providers.
  6. Customer-support and technology providers.
  7. Analytics and marketing providers where legally permitted.
  8. Regulators, courts or government authorities where legally required.

Only information reasonably necessary for the relevant service should be shared.

We do not sell personal information for money. Certain advertising or analytics disclosures may be legally classified as a sale, sharing or targeted advertising in some jurisdictions. Required opt-out rights will be provided where applicable.

6. International Processing

Your information may be processed in the United States, your country, the Seller's country, a fulfillment country or another location used by Service Providers.

Where required, lawful safeguards will be used for international transfers.

7. Retention

Information is retained only for as long as reasonably necessary for:

  1. Order fulfillment and support.
  2. Refunds, warranties and chargebacks.
  3. Tax, accounting and customs requirements.
  4. Fraud prevention and security.
  5. Product recalls and safety obligations.
  6. Legal claims and regulatory compliance.

Information may then be deleted, anonymized or restricted.

8. Security

Reasonable technical, administrative and organizational measures are used to protect personal information.

No online system is completely secure. You must protect your device, account and payment credentials and report suspected unauthorized activity promptly.

9. Marketing

Marketing messages will be sent only where legally permitted.

You may unsubscribe through the link in the message or by contacting support at support@buudy.co.uk.

Order confirmations, security messages, recall notices and other necessary service communications are not marketing.

10. Your Privacy Rights

Depending on your location, you may have the right to:

  1. Access your personal information.
  2. Correct inaccurate information.
  3. Request deletion.
  4. Restrict or object to processing.
  5. Request portable data.
  6. Withdraw consent.
  7. Opt out of certain marketing, profiling, sale or sharing activities.
  8. Appeal a privacy-request decision.
  9. Complain to a data-protection authority.

Legal exceptions may apply where information is required for orders, fraud prevention, safety, accounting or legal claims.

11. Privacy Requests

Submit privacy requests through:

support@buudy.co.uk or Contact Us

We may request reasonable information to verify your identity and protect your data. Requests will be handled within the period required by applicable law.

12. Children

The Store is not intended for children who lack legal capacity to make purchases.

If you believe a child submitted personal information without required authorization, contact Buudy support.

13. Legal Disclosures

Information may be preserved or disclosed where reasonably necessary to comply with law, respond to lawful government requests, investigate fraud, protect legal rights, address security threats or manage a product recall.

14. Mandatory Rights

Mandatory privacy and consumer rights in your jurisdiction remain applicable and prevail over conflicting parts of this Policy.

15. Contact

For questions regarding privacy, contact:

Email: support@buudy.co.uk

Contact form: Contact Us

xPage Drop LLC

131 Continental Dr Suite 305, Newark, DE 19713, United States

Email: support@buudy.co.uk

documents.cookies-policy:
What are cookies?

Cookies are small text files that are placed on your computer by websites that you visit. Our site and our partners use cookies to enhance your experience, analyze traffic and for ad personalization and measurement. You can restrict or block cookies using your browser settings.

How to manage cookies

Some cookies are strictly necessary to allow you to use the website and its features, such as storing items in your basket. Without these cookies these features cannot be provided which may impair the functionality of the website.

You can select the cookies you would like this website to store on your device by changing your browser settings. Details on how to do this in each browser can be found on the ICO website:

https://ico.org.uk/your-data-matters/online/cookies/

You can install a browser add-on to opt-out of Google Analytics across all websites:

https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout

Types of cookies

  • First-party cookies: Set by the website you have accessed to remember your preferences.
  • Third-party cookies: Set by a website other than the one you are accessing.
  • Session cookies: Temporary cookies deleted when you close your browser.
  • Persistent cookies: Remain on your device until erased or expired.

Cookies used on our website

Google Analytics: Collects information in anonymous form about how visitors use our site.

Google Ads: Improves advertising relevancy and reporting.

Google reCAPTCHA: Enhances security and fraud prevention.
